author: Lucario250
quote:
The game is riddled with game breaking bugs. Baseball bats floating in the air when they should be in the hands of an npc. Firetruck getting launched in the air when impacting an npc car, game breaking soft locks forcing you to reload your save file and bugs causing you to lose save data. The protagonists are bland and boring, Niko in gta 4 and the 3 portages and Lamar in gta 5 actually have a personality that doesn't feel like talking to a brick wall. tons of stutters and dips to 20 fps and cops shooting you through solid walls. 

As a furry, the anti furry laws in the game are disgusting. if Rockstar made being trans or gay illegal in gta, there would be far more backlash. How you can kill furries but not activists or protesters is straight up **********. Also being digital only with content locked behind a paywall for a deluxe edition and the collectors edition being an overpriced box of useless crap with no game is disgusting. gta 4 was way better of a story anyway. 0/100

the game is very limited, why can't I shoot up a nightclub? yet I can shoot up a beach, make that make sense. Not being able to cheat or have other relationships is stupid, you could date a ton of different people in gta 4, and that came out in 2008! you could even have a gay relationship in gta 4. I should be able to cheat on Lucia, I should be able to hire pr*stitutes, you could in gta 5, and this is supposed to be an upgrade, where did the 13 years of development go to? oy yea, it went to hair physics and humungous a*ses. 

No settings for first person, and no censorship for streamers. no settings to remove copyrighted songs from the radio or to remove nudity, like come on, Jason lives two blocks away from a bar with 100 fully naked npcs. Rockstar needs to make a decision, you can't make Jason or Lucia fully naked but you can have 100 npcs naked around a pool and bar? how the f**k does that make sense? 

genuinely a huge disappointment, 13 years and they spent most of it on the graphics. they needed to spend more time on the story and more time finding Jason a better voice actor along with needing more time for performance and story writing. Don't even get me started on the bland asf story, how do people say it's entertaining, you are literally playing a simp simulator, running around buying flowers and necklaces while painting walls and fixing stairs. This woke game is nowhere near being a gta game, at best it's a woke read dead game set in a modern world. 

Please do not buy this game, it is horrible. Probably why they did digital only, so nobody could get a refund LMFAO 

If you want to play an actual fun game, go play Zelda. Ocarina of time is a perfect 100/100 and the switch 2 remake runs at a smooth 60 fps with better graphics, story, gameplay and performance :3
